integrity: Analytical proof and self-contained computation instructions are provided; numerical checking is illustrative, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive-discriminant parameters only; no uniformity at the boundary, no higher-moment convergence, and no independent external validation. A publicly established period formula is reused; the occupation law and sharp total-variation coefficient are the present claim.
title: A Cauchy velocity occupation law with a sharp total-variation coefficient in a cubic global center
